get.description:
Members in no active schedule stay in the list with `enrolled` false and an
expected count of 0, so the UI can render them as "not enrolled" instead of
a misleading "0 of 7".
get.summary: Per-member participation for the last N days.

post.summary:
Change a programme. A body with only `enabled` keeps the old toggle
behaviour, so the switch on the card still works unchanged.

get.description:
There was no way to see or change this from the dashboard at all: the
opt-out table has existed since the module shipped and only the person
themselves could write to it, from Slack. An admin could not tell who
had quietly excluded themselves, let alone put somebody back in.
get.summary: Who is in this programme and how each of them stands.

post.summary: Put somebody in, take them out, or snooze them until a date.

post.description:
Without this a programme could not be tried at all until its scheduled
day came round, which is a poor way to find out whether it works.
post.summary: Start a round immediately, rather than waiting for the cadence.

get.summary: Who was put with whom, and whether it happened.

get.description:
`configured` is what lets the page say "not set up on this deployment"
rather than "nobody has connected", which are different problems with
different fixes.
get.summary: Whether Zoom is available here, and how many people have connected.
Who is doing the recognising. The half most tools leave out.

post.summary: Look up a Slack user by name/email and grant them admin role.

get.description:
The registry is read lazily so core keeps no import-time dependency on any
module.
get.summary: Every registered module, with whether it is active for this workspace.

post.description:
Enabling a module whose scopes are not granted returns 409 rather than
silently doing nothing, so the dashboard can offer a re-authorise link
instead of a toggle that appears to work.
post.summary: Enable or disable one module for this workspace.

get.summary: Return standup history with participation stats, filterable by date/member.

get.description:
Every piece is optional on purpose. A workspace with no schedules, no
kudos or no coffee chats still gets a page, because each query returns
empty rather than raising and the counts fall out of whatever arrived.

get.summary: List the event names a webhook can subscribe to.

patch.summary: Update a webhook's URL and/or its event subscription.

get.summary: Recent delivery attempts, newest first, for the team or one webhook.

post.description:
Rotating is also how a pre-signing webhook adopts signing: those rows keep
a NULL secret and deliver unsigned until an operator rotates deliberately,
because turning on signatures behind the receiver's back would break a
strict verifier that has never been given a key.
post.summary: Issue a new signing secret and return it once.
Send a synthetic event through the real signing and logging path.
